capabilities: export a note as a single-page PDF without page breaks
auto-calculate page height from the rendered content at A4 width
preview the rendered content before exporting
export via command palette or file-explorer context menu
extras: The manifest description carries the standard notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes installation steps, usage via command palette and right-click menu, and a brief explanation of the rendering pipeline (MarkdownRenderer plus webview printToPDF).
problem: Obsidian's PDF export paginates long notes across fixed pages, which breaks continuous layouts like long tables or timelines.
summary: PDF exporter that renders a note as one continuous page with no page breaks, auto-sizing the page height to the content at A4 width.
